mapper.select: SELECT g.groups_no AS groupNo, g.groups_name AS groupName, g.groups_description AS groupDesc, g.input_date AS inputDate, g.company_no AS companyNo, g.user_no AS userNo, u.user_name AS leaderName, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM groupsmember gm2 WHERE gm2.groups_no = g.groups_no ) AS memberCount FROM groups g LEFT JOIN users u ON g.user_no = u.user_no WHERE g.company_no = #{companyNo} AND ( g.groups_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM groupsmember gm JOIN users mu ON gm.grp_member_no = mu.user_no WHERE gm.groups_no = g.groups_no AND mu.user_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ) ) ORDER BY g.groups_no DESC
